## Stepper submission

Please include the manufacturer, exact model, NEMA size and all electrical/mechanical values available from the source.

## Verification source

Paste a datasheet/product/PDF URL here, or attach the PDF/image to this issue.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Model / manufacturer verified
- [ ] Electrical values checked against source
- [ ] Units checked
- [ ] Duplicate checked
- [ ] Ready to add to `motors.js`

> Submissions are reviewed before anything is added to the public stepper database.
